shared_elements: rows of closely spaced repeated vertical strokes/short parallel elements
justification: The only correspondence is abstract: both surfaces contain rows of tightly repeated short vertical strokes (the fluted headdress and curl rows in A, the crew-stroke rows above the hulls in B), which is a generic repetition device rather than a shared motif. A depicts a large naturalistic human head in profile with modelled eye, patterned beard and hair, while B shows small schematic outline boats with upcurved prows stacked in registers on open rock; there is no shared subject matter or relationship.
